remediation_scope: Expose accepted as a known external provider effect without promoting it to sent.
Preserve accepted in the response when post-outbound tracking persistence fails.
Keep delivery null for skipped+skipped so no-effect remains distinguishable.

focused_controls.method: exact-SHA code/test inspection + six-case decision harness
focused_controls.positive: accepted+accepted returns delivery with both accepted
focused_controls.negative: emailSent/whatsappSent remain false and sentAt remains null

focused_controls.positive: accepted remains in response after tracking persistence failure
focused_controls.negative: known provider effect is not erased to null and is not promoted to sent

focused_controls.positive: toast states provider accepted and awaits delivery confirmation
focused_controls.negative: toast does not say notification was sent

focused_controls.detail: accepted+accepted, accepted+skipped, skipped+skipped, sent+skipped, failed+skipped, not_configured+skipped all matched expected exposure semantics.
